note: S92 golden distance table. THE MODEL IS PINNED, not just the numbers: an ellipsoidal geodesic differs from spherical haversine by up to ~0.5% — twenty-plus miles on a Hawaii-Maine pair — so a table taken from an online calculator would fail a CORRECT implementation for the right-looking reason. Rows flagged discriminatesModel are the long and exotic ones; a planar approximation must fail every one of them, and cannot be told apart from great-circle on the short American pairs.

rows.method: spherical haversine, mean radius 3958.7613 mi, computed in Python 3 (math.sin/cos/asin) from the exact serialized world-file coordinates — an independent IMPLEMENTATION of the same model, not an online calculator
